items.title: Frozen Blast Furnace: What Happens When It Solidifies
items.description:
What happens during a frozen blast furnace emergency, and why does shutting one down create a multi-million dollar disaster? We examine the extreme thermodynamic equilibrium keeping industrial ironmaking alive, the catastrophic birth of a subterranean salamander, and the explosive techniques used to bring these colossal structures back to life. #engineering #materials #manufacturing

Chapters:
0:00 What Is a Frozen Blast Furnace
1:19 Why Blast Furnaces Run Nonstop
3:04 The Thermodynamics of Smelting
4:56 How a Freeze Actually Starts
6:41 The Frozen Hearth and the Salamander
8:29 How Engineers Dynamited the Beast
